Module 11 · Session 11.1 · 30 min

Branch, DSA and field-operations architecture

A source-linked technical walkthrough with an executable-system perspective.

After this session, you can:
  • Trace territory and assignment
  • Operate offline safely
  • Preserve conduct and cash evidence

Technical flow

1. Operational hierarchy

Branch, agency, manager, field officer and DSA relationships constrain territory, capacity, product and task assignment. Revocation and expiry stop new work immediately.

2. Offline is bounded

Mobile apps cache only an encrypted, time-boxed workset. Commands carry version and idempotency evidence; server reconciliation rejects stale authority or conflicting state.

3. Field proof

Visits, geo/time evidence, customer acknowledgement, recovery-agent notice, receipts and same-day cash posting retain device and actor lineage with privacy minimization.
